title: Independent numerical checks
statement: Finite numerical validation against 80- and90-digit mpmath references, including log-polar compactified tails. These are not interval-certified error bounds, root completeness, or an RH proof.

errorMetric.interpretation: Observed scaled error at finite checked points; relative error at a zero is not claimed.

checks.label: Core: zeta and xi against 80-digit values
checks.method: Independent mpmath zeta and gamma formula

checks.label: Core: heat against unshifted theta quadrature
checks.method: Independent direct real-axis integration at 80 digits

additionalChecks: Heat at tau=0 equals xi, including contour-shift boundaries
Classical heat PDE sign and factor one quarter
Zeta pole and removable xi singularities
First 25 reference zeros and nonzero off-line neighbours
Theta positivity samples and doubled-grid heat diagnostic
Raw underflow and overflow preserve valid log-polar values
HardyZ beyond the old complex Gamma overflow threshold
Explicit domain rejection and refined heat diagnostics below raw underflow

extendedChecks.label: Extended zeta and xi against 90-digit references
extendedChecks.method: Independent mpmath zeta/gamma log magnitudes, phases, derivatives and HardyZ

extendedChecks.label: Extended heat against 90-digit convolution
extendedChecks.method: Independently computed 80-node Gauss–Hermite rule at 90 decimal digits; app uses 32 nodes

extendedErrorMetric.logMagnitude: absolute difference of natural logarithms of |F|
extendedErrorMetric.derivativeLogMagnitude: absolute difference of natural logarithms of |F_prime|

heatExtended.identity: F_tau(s)=pi^(-1/2) integral_R exp(-v^2) xi(s+sqrt(tau)*v) dv; sqrt(tau)=i*sqrt(-tau) for negative tau
heatExtended.method: 32-node Gauss–Hermite outside the core window; 64-node convergence diagnostic
